records.title: CN1 MUTANT and The Lab
records.body: Owner checkpoint Nov 6: CN1 MUTANT's public presentation is called The Underground Experiment; the CN1 website MUTANT card opens the separate MUTANT homepage, not a forced jump into the lab. The laboratory is branded THE BLACK LAB at mutant.eggplantqueen.lol/black-lab/. The owner verified a copy-only cleanup: zero visible 3D-tool references on the MUTANT homepage, technical version labels removed from public copy, existing navigation and original 3D/gameplay unchanged. A complete 3D browser start was not verified by this receipt: an earlier test stalled at CALIBRATING SYSTEMS. NEX and the Seed are present; real guild inventory, public votes, global Seed changes and full mechanical animation are not live.

records.title: NEX assistant and how to ask
records.body: Owner-observed November 4: NEX answers direct community project questions using dated public records and is a separate assistant from CN1. The owner installed and successfully tested its X Radar group pilot: a selected X post can be previewed for human approval or dismissal before the link is shared voluntarily in Telegram. NEX does not continuously search X by itself, cannot certify X engagement, and does not issue XP or alter the Raid Bot. No mass tags, automatic X replies or forced group campaigns are part of this pilot.

records.title: CN1 the CLUB
records.body: The CLUB is an owner-reported live and evolving 3D social/music space, according to the public CN1 status of 2026-09-29. Avatars, game-room activity and social features continue to evolve. This does not confirm that every arcade station, multiplayer feature, roulette variant or reward is publicly accessible in every build.

records.title: CN1 Demon Drift
records.body: The owner reported Chapter I publicly released by 2026-10-31. Later chapters remain in development, with a focus on better movement, discovery and companion-led clues. Guild integrations and later-story features are design work, not confirmed live. Check the official Arcade for current playable access.

records.title: CN1 BAD DECISIONS
records.body: The owner has tested Room 1 combat updates and experiments for later areas including Liquidity Mall and a DOOM-like room. Loot, Scrap, crafting and equipment upgrades are under development; do not assume planned trading, shared XP or every prototype room is live.

records.title: Lower Rooms
records.body: Owner-reported private technical tests included room create/join, human 1v1 combat, avatars, damage, kills, respawn and combat effects. Broader multiplayer work continues. Full public 2v2 availability is not verified by this checkpoint.

records.title: CN1 guilds
records.body: The owner reported a limited private Guilds R16 beta with help and read-only NFT-related functions. Links to Demon Drift, shared items and guild resource systems remain staged work. Public signup, XP entitlement and unrestricted transfers are not established.

records.title: CN1 DJ Lab
records.body: The owner tested a multi-minute mixing timeline and work on easier sound selection, audio handling and interface design. This remains an experimental workstream; the exact deployed build, audio quality and public access need a separate current check.

records.title: CN1 Comics and Sunday stories
records.body: The CN1 comic/BD series has recurring Sunday publications shared by its creator through community channels. Its art direction and humor connect to CN1's larger universe. A specific future episode, numbering or public release time should not be assumed from this archived record.

records.title: CN1 website
records.body: The owner reports the official CN1 public website at eggplantqueen.lol is online and that its MUTANT card correctly opens the MUTANT homepage, mutant.eggplantqueen.lol. From that homepage, visitors can enter the separately branded The Black Lab laboratory. The public MUTANT titles/labels were cleaned up in the Nov 6 owner-verified checkpoint; an old Telegram link preview may remain cached. Other CN1 website areas include dedicated Shop and Community Arcade presentation work, but this record is not proof of a live checkout, open community ballots or a fully completed catalogue. Do not claim the old November 3 'homepage still pending publication' status is current.

records.title: CN1 Raid Bot
records.body: CN1's existing Telegram Raid Bot supports optional community missions around selected X posts. Administrators can configure mission duration and limits; optional participation and reward rules belong to the CN1 Raid system, not NEX. A manual completion signal must not be described as independently verified X likes or replies. The Raid Bot is separate from NEX X Radar. A future integration might be explored, but none is confirmed live. No pressure, spam or copy-paste campaigns are supported.

records.title: CN1 X Radar
records.body: Owner-reported November 4: NEX X Radar is installed and tested as an owner-controlled Telegram pilot. A curated X conversation can be previewed with clear human approval or dismissal; the public post link is not released to the group until the owner authorizes it. Participation is optional and meant for original discussion, not raids or guaranteed interaction. This pilot does not automatically search all of X, post replies or award XP; a production integration with the separate Raid Bot remains future work.

records.title: CN1 X discovery and post watch
records.body: CN1 is using a human-curated process to identify relevant X discussions about Solana, memecoins, Web3 gaming, Telegram community tooling and related culture. Suggestions are reviewed before community sharing or publishing; NEX X Radar currently uses owner-selected links, not an always-on automated X discovery source. A direct automated watch-to-NEX integration is in development and may require licensed data access or an X API with limits and costs. It is not an included live paid-API product, and no automatic engagement or mass tagging is provided.

records.title: CN1 MUTANT 3D machines and lab effects
records.body: As of Nov 6: the underground 3D lab source has a larger reactor/Seed chamber and modular machine components for the Relay scanner, Distiller, Chiller, Black Box, pressure/power stations, containment lock, lighting, wall machinery, monitoring frame and biotech pod. The owner previously approved meaningful visual work; the newest successful deployment receipt confirms the public wording cleanup, not a completed browser playthrough or an independent health check of every model. Next: verify the full Black Lab load, animate physical controls, make fluids and effects convincing, and refine the mood without blocking paths. The existing vial/containment/Black Box exercises are local practice only. Say 'original CN1 3D models' rather than naming the modelling software or internal release numbers.
